signIn.title: Staff sign-in
signIn.intro: Sign in with your organisation account. A second factor is required.
signIn.failed: Could not sign in. Try again.

mfa.title: Second factor required
mfa.body: Your organisation requires a second factor. Sign in again and complete it.

escalations.title: Escalations
escalations.emptyDescription: Nothing in this list right now.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.emptyDescription: No items waiting for a decision.
moderation.verificationHint: Approving makes her a verified member.

blockAuthor.label: Also suspend the author
blockAuthor.hint: She will not be able to post or write in chats until an admin lifts the suspension. For serious or repeated cases.

legalHoldOption.label: Keep for legal review
legalHoldOption.hint: Preserves the content for the lawyer (legal hold), even after it is taken down.

blockConfirm.title: Reject and suspend the author?
blockConfirm.message: The item will be rejected and its author suspended. Only an admin can lift the suspension.

legalHold.stateUnknown: The current hold state is not shown here. Choose the action you need.
legalHold.putTitle: Put this message on legal hold?
legalHold.putMessage: The message will be preserved for the lawyer until the hold is released.
legalHold.putDone: The message is on legal hold.
legalHold.releaseMessage: The message will follow the usual retention period again.

moderation.alreadyDecided: Someone has already decided this item. The list is refreshed.

duty.title: Duty roster
duty.emptyDescription: Add a shift for the current week.

phone.label: On-duty phone
phone.hint: E.164, for example +70000000000. Stored encrypted, never shown again.

duty.invalid: Check the fields and try again.

articles.title: Knowledge
articles.emptyDescription: Create a draft or change the filters.

editor.title: Draft editor

sourceUrl.label: Source URL
sourceUrl.hint: Required for rights articles at publication

editor.invalid: Check the fields and try again.

topic.title: New topic
topic.invalid: Check the fields and try again.

review.title: Review queue
review.emptyDescription: No versions are waiting for review.
review.author: Author {{id}}

reviewDue.title: Review due
reviewDue.emptyDescription: No published versions need a review yet.

problem.forbidden: This action belongs to another role. Another reviewer may be needed, or you authored this version.
problem.conflict: This version cannot be changed right now: its status has changed. Refresh the list.

actions.failed: The request did not go through. Try again.

notAvailable.title: Not on this server yet
notAvailable.description: This list is not available on this server yet. It will appear after the next server update.

members.title: Members
members.emptyVerifiedDescription: Members appear here once their verification is approved.
members.emptySuspendedDescription: Members suspended by a moderation decision appear here.
members.liftMessage: She will be able to post and write in chats again.
members.liftForbidden: Only an admin can lift a suspension. Ask an admin of this deployment.

mentor.grantMessage: {{name}} gets the mentor role. Then you can assign her to a room in Rooms.
mentor.revokeMessage: {{name}} loses the mentor role and stops being a mentor in every room she mentors.
mentor.granted: She now has the mentor role. Assign her to a room in Rooms.
mentor.conflict: The mentor role can be given only to a verified member who is not suspended.
mentor.notAvailable: The mentor role cannot be changed on this server yet. It will work after the next server update.
mentor.stateUnknown: Whether she already has the mentor role is not shown here. Choose the action you need; both are safe to repeat.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.removeMessage: {{name}} will no longer be a mentor of {{room}}.
rooms.emptyDescription: District and topic rooms appear here once they are created.
rooms.conflict: She cannot be made a mentor of this room. Only a verified member with the mentor role can be assigned.

pick.title: Choose a mentor
pick.intro: Verified members. Tap one to make her a mentor of {{room}}.
pick.mentorsOnly: Only a member with the mentor role can be assigned. Give the role in Members.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.emptyDescription: No staff actions match these filters. Change a filter or the dates.
audit.forbiddenTitle: Only an admin can see this
audit.forbiddenDescription: The audit log and staff cards are open to the admins of this deployment.

filter.dayInvalid: Enter a real date as YYYY-MM-DD.
filter.rangeInvalid: The end date is before the start date.

action.chat_message_legal_hold_on: Put a message on legal hold
action.chat_member_mute: Muted a member in a room
action.chat_member_ban: Banned a member from a room
action.chat_member_unban: Let a member back into a room
action.emergency_plan_view_external: Opened a sent emergency plan by its link

staff.title: Staff
staff.emptyDescription: A staff member appears here after their first sign-in to this deployment.
staff.noActionsDescription: Older entries are in the audit log.
staff.notFoundDescription: Go back to the staff list and choose the person again.

metrics.title: Pilot metrics
metrics.intro: Totals for the pilot over a period, never about one person. Each view and download is recorded in the audit log.
metrics.kNote: Numbers built from fewer than {{k}} members are hidden to protect privacy.

period.label: Period
period.reversed: The end date is before the start date.
period.tooLong: A period can be at most 12 months long. Choose a later start or an earlier end.
period.invalid: The server cannot show this period: the end must not be before the start and at most 12 months after it. Choose another period.

metrics.downloadFailed: Could not download the file. Please try again in a moment.
metrics.forbiddenTitle: Only an admin can see metrics
metrics.forbiddenDescription: Pilot metrics are open to the admins of this deployment.
metrics.suppressed: Fewer than {{k}} members — hidden to protect privacy

activity.title: Activity
activity.about: How many members used the app at least once in each week and each month.

retention.title: Retention
retention.about: Of the members whose first active day falls in the period, the share still active 4 and 8 weeks later. Only members whose window has already ended count.

tea.title: Tea meetings
tea.about: The way to meeting in person: requests for a tea, matches both members accepted, and pairs who confirmed they met.

sos.title: SOS
sos.about: SOS requests raised in the period, the share of them closed, and the median minutes until the first member responded.

escalations.title: Escalations
escalations.about: Escalations to staff opened in the period, and the share taken within 15 minutes.

rights.title: Rights
rights.about: Questions about rights answered from the reviewed knowledge base, and the share of those replies rated helpful.

stress.title: Stress (PSS-4)
stress.about: PSS-4 score of members whose first check-in falls in the period: at that check-in and at the one nearest to 8 weeks later (6–10 weeks). A lower score means less stress.

isolation.title: Isolation
isolation.about: Isolation score of the same members before and after, counted the same way as stress.

activity.empty: Nothing to show for this period yet.

sos.title: SOS requests
sos.intro: Each request also went to her confirmed trusted contacts when she raised it. Press “Seen” so other moderators know someone is on it, and close it when the need is met or no longer current.
sos.emptyOpenDescription: A new SOS appears here as soon as a member raises it. The list refreshes every 30 seconds.
sos.emptyClosedDescription: Requests closed by the member, by a moderator or automatically appear here.
sos.forbiddenTitle: Only moderators and admins see SOS
sos.forbiddenDescription: SOS requests are open to the moderators and admins of this deployment.

type.childcare: No one to leave the child with
type.item_or_medicine: Urgently needs an item or medicine

sos.childcareOnly: Goes only to her trusted contacts and the moderators. It is never shared to the district.
sos.author: From: {{name}}
sos.districtUnknown: District: not in the reference list

closeConfirm.title: Close this SOS?
closeConfirm.message: It leaves the open queue and her district feed, and the automatic close is cancelled. She does not get a notification.

sos.gone: This request is no longer here. The list has been refreshed.
